text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghal says no serious incidents on the Kuwait-Iraq border. He recommends a six-month extension for U.N. Iraq-Kuwait Observation Mission.
- Wafra International Investment Company sets up fund with $30-$50 million capital which may be doubled.
- Kuwait says a non-provoking Iraqi attitude is required.
- Palestinian official Faisal al-Husseini says Middle East peace process is dying.

- Kuwaiti women to hold sit-in and silent march on Monday to demand political rights on election day. Kuwaiti men will vote next week in parliamentary elections but women are not allowed to take part.
